messages.subject: Using shinyGridster with selectInput
parts:
Hi guys,

I have a question -- I'm trying to use shinyGridster, but it seems that selectInput elements placed inside a gridsterItem can't be clicked when multiple=TRUE. I placed a small example gist one can run at at:

    runGist("https://gist.github.com/kevinushey/6600690")

Is there any way around this? I'm guessing gridster is intercepting the mouse clicks and it's not getting through to the select box?

messages.author: 8129606756857cb3
messages.subject: Re: Using shinyGridster with selectInput
parts:
Not really a full blown solution, but a workaround -- the gridster js API exports two functions, .enable / .disable, that can be used to dynamically turn gridster functionality off and on. One can use that to temporarily disable gridster while trying to access a multi-select menu. http://gridster.net/#enable_method for documentation.

One could be clever and disable/re-enable gridster on mouseover for those elements.

-Kevin
